name: Hide_1
short_caption: The robot brings both hands up to cover its mouth in a shocked or secretive 'oops' gesture, then returns to neutral.
movement_description: The robot raises both arms from its sides, bringing its hands together in front of its mouth. It holds them there, fingers slightly overlapping as if gasping or whispering a secret, while keeping its head facing forward. After a brief pause in this pose, it lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to a neutral standing posture.
safety_notes: The arms fold inwards towards the chest and mouth, keeping the risk of hitting external objects low.
